meta.name: paid-ads-creative
meta.description: Create grounded paid-media creative concepts, copy angles, refresh hypotheses, and measurable test briefs across advertising platforms. Use for ad copy, creative briefs, UGC concepts, headlines, creative fatigue, asset ideas, or a creative refresh.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出有依据的广告创意与测试方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责付费广告投放,需要持续产出有效创意和文案。
copy.tagline_en: Generate ad creative concepts, copy angles, and measurable test briefs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid ads and need fresh, effective creative ideas and copy angles.

howto.what: 生成三张付费广告创意概念卡,每张含受众假设、文案钩子、CTA、视觉简报和测试指标;只依据你提供的真实证据,不虚构数据。
howto.when: 当你说要写广告文案、做创意简报或诊断素材疲劳等创意需求时触发。

say.text: 为这个瑜伽课程写三条广告头条,投放 Facebook,受众是年轻妈妈。
say.note: Claude 会产出三张概念卡,含钩子和假设。

say.text: 现有广告跑量下滑,帮我诊断是否创意疲劳,给出刷新假设。
say.note: 它会基于频率、CTR 等判断后再给建议。

say.text: 基于这份客户访谈记录,为该新品做创意简报和成功指标。
say.note: 它会对照证据来源,标记未证实的声明。

howto.what_en: Generate three ad creative concept cards, each with audience hypothesis, hook, CTA, visual brief, and test metrics; grounded only in provided evidence without fabrication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked for ad copy, creative briefs, or fatigue diagnosis for paid media creative.

say_en.text: Write three ad headlines for this yoga course on Facebook, targeting young moms.
say_en.note: It produces three concept cards with hooks and hypotheses.

say_en.text: My ad performance is declining—diagnose creative fatigue and suggest refresh hypotheses.
say_en.note: It checks frequency, CTR, etc. before recommending.

say_en.text: Create a creative brief and success metrics for this new product from the interview notes.
say_en.note: It uses evidence and marks unsubstantiated claims.
